title: spec-kitty feedback --agent-check --trigger <t> --agent <key> --json
description: Tells an agent harness whether to present the Feedback Survey now. Computed locally (no network). When action is 'prompt', the offer has already been recorded as shown; the agent must ask the human with its native question UI and must never answer on the human's behalf.

survey.description: Present only when action is 'prompt'. Fixed wording the agent should render.

comment_max_length.description: The agent must tell the user before the consent step if their comment exceeds this and will be cut.

rating_question.const: How would you rate your experience? (1-5)

comment_question.const: What would you change? (optional, up to 2000 characters)

email_question.const: Email, only if you want to sign your feedback (optional)
